message: Lead inspection of 94aef9b1 found two issues to address before frozen re-review. (1) Client/SignalR/Client.fs activityFencedByCommand exempts CompleteIntegration as supposedly advancing owner/agent version, but ReviewWorkflow.completeIntegration (~990-1018) only writes IntegrationSubmission status, not agent/task/attempt version. A Working agent can complete integration without fencing its recent activity, leaving stale operator correction CAS valid. Add negative test, audit all exempt commands similarly. (2) recordWorkingActivity invokes LedgerStore.transact for EVERY ordinary call of an already Working agent, including read-only; this implies remote Git fetch/commit/push plus trust-binding lock on hot path, and blocks reads when writes are unavailable. Please benchmark realistic 100+ calls (wall time, subprocesses, ledger growth, failures) and reconsider architecture; correctness must not destroy normal tool latency/availability. Do not freeze/submit until this trade-off and the exemption bug are resolved and independently tested.
